def rotate_point(x: float, y: float, angle: float) -> Tuple[float, float]:
    rad = math.radians(angle)
    cos_a = math.cos(rad)
    sin_a = math.sin(rad)

def get_vertices(w: int, h: int, angle: int) -> List[Tuple[float, float]]:

    ]

                q[1] <= max(p[1], r[1]) and q[1] >= min(p[1], r[1]))

        n = len(points)

            area += points[i][0] * points[j][1]
            area -= points[j][0] * points[i][1]
        area = abs(area) / 2.0
        return area

    def compute_intersection(rect1: List[Tuple[float, float]], rect2: List[Tuple[float, float]]) -> List[Tuple[float, float]]:
        intersection_points = []
        for i in range(4):
            for j in range(4):
